name: @hookswap/gateway-adapter
description: GraphQL gateway-schema adapter for HookSwap. Serves the EXACT Uniswap gateway GraphQL schema the HookSwap interface calls (AWS_API_ENDPOINT), backed by HookSwap's self-hosted v3-subgraph (graph-node) for pool/token/price ops, and proxies every unimplemented operation (portfolio balances, NFTs, token projects/CMS, v2/v4) to the real Uniswap gateway. Lets the interface's AWS_API_ENDPOINT point here instead of Uniswap's hosted gateway (which only serves Uniswap chains).
